blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Erwin Tulfo expressed sadness on Monday after three minority senators reportedly voted in favor of reconsidering a petition to oust him in the upper chamber. This came a few days after the Senate Electoral Tribunal (SET) dismissed the motion for reconsideration filed by disbarred lawyer Berteni Causing to unseat Tulfo due to allegedly retaining his American citizenship, his membership in a political dynasty, and lack of academic qualifications. The SET is composed of three Supreme Court associate justices, Sens. Bam Aquino, Kiko Pangilinan and Lito Lapid from the majority bloc; and Sens. Pia Cayetano, Camille Villar, and […]...
